# sampleSizeCalc

> Sample Size Calculator for Clinical Research

A comprehensive R package for sample size determination across **39
design combinations**: experimental trials (superiority /
non-inferiority / equivalence), observational studies (cohort,
case-control, cross-sectional), diagnostic accuracy studies (estimation,
testing, comparison, AUC), and complex designs (cluster RCT, Simon
two-stage, bioequivalence, ordered outcomes, prediction models,
interrupted time series).

Every result carries: the formula (plain text + LaTeX), precise
literature references (section/page level), parameter-role
documentation, and methodological hints.

## Installation

``` r

devtools::install_github("portos-wang/sampleSizeCalc")
# or from a local source
devtools::install_local("path/to/Sample_Size_Calc")
```

## Quick start: the three-axis API

``` r

library(sampleSizeCalc)

# design x task x outcome
calculate("rct", "test", "mean",
  mean1 = 10, mean2 = 12, sd = 3
)
calculate("rct", "noninferiority", "proportion",
  p1 = 0.90, p2 = 0.85, margin = 0.05
)
calculate("cohort", "test", "proportion",
  p0 = 0.20, p1 = 0.30, ratio = 2, dropout = 0.10
)
calculate("caseControl", "test", "proportion", p0 = 0.3, OR = 2.0)
calculate("diagAccuracy", "estimate", "proportion",
  prob = 0.85, d = 0.05, prevalence = 0.2
)
calculate("diagAUC", "estimate", "auc",
  auc = 0.80, d = 0.10, ratio = 1, var_method = "binormal"
)
calculate("singleArmPhaseII", "test", "proportion",
  p0 = 0.1, p1 = 0.3, optimizer = "optimal"
)
calculate("clusterRCT", "test", "mean",
  mean1 = 10, mean2 = 12, sd = 3, icc = 0.05, cluster_size = 20
)
calculate("bioequivalence", "equivalence", "mean", cv = 0.25)
```

Unambiguous designs allow omitting `task`/`outcome`:

``` r

calculate("diagAUC", auc = 0.80, d = 0.05)
calculate("singleProportion", p = 0.30, precision = 0.05)   # -> 323
```

Illegal combinations error with the list of legal ones. The full design
x task x outcome table, formulas, and sources live in
[docs/DESIGN_MATRIX.md](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/docs/DESIGN_MATRIX.md);
published worked examples used as numeric test anchors are catalogued in
[docs/NUMERIC_ANCHORS.md](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/docs/NUMERIC_ANCHORS.md).

## Legacy API (silently compatible)

All 17 pre-3.0 keywords keep working with identical results:

``` r

sample_size_calculator("twoMeans", mean1 = 10, mean2 = 12, sd = 3)  # 37/group
sample_size_calculator("survival", hr = 0.7)                        # 65 events
```

## Result object

[`calculate()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate.md)
returns a `sample_size_result` S3 object with
[`print()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/print.html),
[`summary()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/summary.html) and
[`plot()`](https://rdrr.io/r/graphics/plot.default.html) methods.
[`print()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/print.html) shows the metrics, the
role of each parameter under the chosen design, and any methodological
hints; [`summary()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/summary.html) adds the
formula, LaTeX, precise references and the adjustment audit trail.

## Study designs (family overview)

| Family | Designs |
|----|----|
| Trials | `rct` (test/NI/superiority/equivalence x mean/proportion/rate/survival), `paired` (mean/proportion), `rctSingleArm`, `crossover`, `bioequivalence`, `singleArmPhaseII` (Simon optimal/minimax, A’Hern) |
| Observational | `cohort` (proportion/rate), `caseControl`, `caseControlMatched`, `crosstab` |
| Diagnostic | `diagAccuracy` (estimate/test/dual-endpoint), `diagAccuracyCompare` (test/NI/equivalence), `diagAUC`, `diagAUCCompare` (test/NI/equivalence), `diagLR` |
| Estimation | `singleProportion`, `singleMean`, `singleCorrelation` |
| Complex | `clusterRCT`, `twoOrdinal`, `predictiveModel`, `its` (experimental) |
| Deferred | `kappa`, `steppedWedge` (formula sources under verification) |

## Literature

Methods are anchored to primary sources, with worked examples from the
reference literature used as automated numeric test benchmarks:

- Zhou, Obuchowski & McClish (2011). *Statistical Methods in Diagnostic
  Medicine* (2nd ed.), Wiley - diagnostic module.
- Machin, Campbell, Tan & Tan (2018). *Sample Sizes for Clinical,
  Laboratory and Epidemiology Studies* (4th ed.), Wiley - trial/complex
  designs.
- Hajian-Tilaki (2014). *J Biomed Informatics* 48:193-204 - diagnostic
  formulas.
- Akoglu (2022). *Turkish J Emergency Medicine* 22(4):177-185 -
  diagnostic comparisons and dual-endpoint strategy.
- Bhardwaj et al. (2024). *J Family Med Prim Care* 13(7):2555-2561 -
  prevalence studies and dropout adjustment.
- Plus the original methods: Schoenfeld (1983), Fleiss et al. (1980),
  Casagrande et al. (1978), Schlesselman (1982), Dupont (1988), Connor
  (1987), Hanley & McNeil (1982/1983), Buderer (1996), Simon (1989),
  A’Hern (2001), Whitehead (1993), Peduzzi et al. (1996), Schuirmann
  (1987).

## Citation

If you use the package in research, please cite the original methodology
papers for each design (listed in every result’s `reference` field)
along with the package:

``` bibtex
@software{sampleSizeCalc,
  title = {sampleSizeCalc: Sample Size Calculator for Clinical Research},
  author = {Portos (Yishan) Wang and Bingxin Cai},
  organization = {Gansu Provincial Maternity and Child-care Hospital (Gansu Provincial Central Hospital)},
  year = {2026},
  version = {3.1.0},
  url = {https://github.com/portos-wang/sampleSizeCalc}
}
```

# Package index

## Unified Three-Axis API / 统一三轴入口

Primary entry points supporting 39+ study design combinations (design x
task x outcome) and legacy single-keyword compatibility.

- [`calculate()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate.md)
  : Unified sample size calculator (three-axis API)
- [`sample_size_calculator()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/sample_size_calculator.md)
  [`sampleSizeCalculator()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/sample_size_calculator.md)
  : Sample size calculator for clinical study designs (legacy API)

## Results Display & Visualisation / 结果输出与绘图

S3 print, summary, and ggplot2 visual diagnostic methods for
sample_size_result objects.

- [`print(`*`<sample_size_result>`*`)`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/print.sample_size_result.md)
  : Print method for sample_size_result objects
- [`summary(`*`<sample_size_result>`*`)`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/summary.sample_size_result.md)
  : Summary method for sample_size_result objects
- [`plot(`*`<sample_size_result>`*`)`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/plot.sample_size_result.md)
  : Plot sample size calculation result
- [`plot_power_curve()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/plot_power_curve.md)
  : Plot power curve
- [`plot_sample_size_comparison()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/plot_sample_size_comparison.md)
  : Plot sample size comparison

## Clinical Trials (RCTs) / 随机对照试验

Calculations for parallel-group randomised controlled trials across
continuous, binary, and time-to-event outcomes, covering superiority,
non-inferiority, and equivalence.

- [`calculate_two_means()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_two_means.md)
  : Two independent means comparison calculation
- [`calculate_two_proportions()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_two_proportions.md)
  : Two independent proportions comparison calculation
- [`calculate_survival()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_survival.md)
  : Survival analysis (log-rank test) calculation
- [`calculate_superiority_means()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_superiority_means.md)
  : Superiority test (means) calculation
- [`calculate_superiority_proportions()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_superiority_proportions.md)
  : Superiority test (proportions) calculation
- [`calculate_non_inferiority_means()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_non_inferiority_means.md)
  : Non-inferiority test (means) calculation
- [`calculate_non_inferiority_proportions()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_non_inferiority_proportions.md)
  : RCT non-inferiority for proportions (fills the legacy margin gap)
- [`calculate_equivalence_means()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_equivalence_means.md)
  : Equivalence test (means) calculation
- [`calculate_equivalence_proportions()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_equivalence_proportions.md)
  : Equivalence test (proportions) calculation

## Paired, Single-Arm & Crossover Designs / 配对、单臂与交叉设计

Within-subject paired comparisons, single-arm trials against historical
benchmarks, Simon two-stage designs, A’Hern single-stage, and 2x2
bioequivalence crossover trials.

- [`calculate_paired_means()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_paired_means.md)
  : Paired means comparison calculation
- [`calculate_paired_proportions()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_paired_proportions.md)
  : Paired binary outcomes (McNemar test sample size)
- [`calculate_single_arm_mean()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_single_arm_mean.md)
  : Single-arm trial: continuous outcome vs a fixed reference value n =
  (Z_a/2 + Z_b)^2 \* sigma^2 / delta^2 (Machin Ch.5, single-sample)
- [`calculate_single_arm_proportion()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_single_arm_proportion.md)
  : Single-arm trial: binary outcome vs a fixed reference proportion
- [`calculate_simon_two_stage()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_simon_two_stage.md)
  : Single-arm phase II: Simon two-stage design (exact search)
- [`calculate_ahern()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_ahern.md)
  : Single-arm phase II: A'Hern single-stage design (exact search)
- [`calculate_crossover_mean()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_crossover_mean.md)
  : 2x2 crossover, continuous outcome (within-subject SD
  parameterization)
- [`calculate_bioequivalence()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_bioequivalence.md)
  : Bioequivalence (2x2 crossover, exact TOST noncentral t, 80-125%)

## Observational & Epidemiological Studies / 观察性流行病学研究

Sample size calculations for prospective cohort studies (cumulative
incidence and person-time rate), unmatched/matched case-control studies,
and cross-sectional prevalence surveys.

- [`calculate_cohort_proportion()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_cohort_proportion.md)
  : Cohort study: exposed vs unexposed cumulative incidence (1:m
  allocation)
- [`calculate_cohort_rate()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_cohort_rate.md)
  : Cohort study: incidence rate comparison (person-time, Poisson)
- [`calculate_case_control()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_case_control.md)
  : Case-control study calculation
- [`calculate_case_control_matched()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_case_control_matched.md)
  : Individually matched (1:1) case-control study
- [`calculate_crosstab_association()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_crosstab_association.md)
  : Cross-sectional study: association between exposure and prevalence

## Single-Sample Precision Estimation / 单组参数置信区间估计

Determination of sample sizes required to estimate a population
proportion (prevalence), continuous mean, or Pearson correlation
coefficient with a target margin of error.

- [`calculate_single_proportion()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_single_proportion.md)
  : Internal calculation: single proportion precision (absolute or
  relative)
- [`calculate_single_mean()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_single_mean.md)
  : Internal calculation: single mean precision
- [`calculate_single_correlation()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_single_correlation.md)
  : Internal calculation: single correlation coefficient precision
  (Fisher z / Machin)

## Diagnostic Accuracy Studies / 诊断试验准确性研究

End-to-end sample size determination for diagnostic accuracy studies:
sensitivity/specificity estimation, single/dual-endpoint hypothesis
testing, paired/unpaired comparisons, ROC-AUC (estimation, testing,
margins), and likelihood ratios.

- [`calculate_diagnostic_accuracy_v2()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_diagnostic_accuracy_v2.md)
  : Upgraded diagnostic accuracy: Zhou Eq 6.1 (CI width + power), Eq 6.2
  (precision), Eq 6.3 (prevalence guarantee) — Zhou 2011 pp.194-196
- [`calculate_diagnostic_superiority_single()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_diagnostic_superiority_single.md)
  : Diagnostic superiority (single test) calculation
- [`calculate_diagnostic_comparison_two()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_diagnostic_comparison_two.md)
  : Diagnostic comparison (two tests) calculation
- [`calculate_diag_compare_margin_prop()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_diag_compare_margin_prop.md)
  : Two-proportion margin designs (non-inferiority / equivalence)
- [`calculate_auc_single_v2()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_auc_single_v2.md)
  : Upgraded AUC estimation: three variance functions, user-set
  case:control ratio R — Zhou 2011 pp.196-199
- [`calculate_auc_superiority()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_auc_superiority.md)
  : AUC superiority test calculation
- [`calculate_auc_comparison()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_auc_comparison.md)
  : AUC comparison (two tests) calculation
- [`calculate_diag_auc_compare_margin()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_diag_auc_compare_margin.md)
  : AUC margin designs (non-inferiority / equivalence of two ROC areas)
- [`calculate_likelihood_ratio_v2()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_likelihood_ratio_v2.md)
  : Likelihood ratio sample size via log(LR) CI (Hajian-Tilaki Eq
  6.13/6.14)
- [`screen_required()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/screen_required.md)
  : Total screening size with probability guarantee (Zhou Eq 6.3)
- [`mrmc_power()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/mrmc_power.md)
  : MRMC study power (Obuchowski-Rockette mixed model, paired-patient
  paired-reader design)

## Complex & Modern Clinical Designs / 复杂与现代临床研究设计

Methodologies for cluster randomised trials (design effects),
stepped-wedge cluster trials, ordered categorical outcomes, clinical
prediction model sample size, and interrupted time series.

- [`calculate_cluster_mean()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_cluster_mean.md)
  : Cluster RCT wrapping the two-means kernel
- [`calculate_cluster_proportion()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_cluster_proportion.md)
  : Cluster RCT wrapping the two-proportions kernel
- [`apply_cluster_design()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/apply_cluster_design.md)
  : Apply the cluster design effect to an individually-randomised result
- [`calculate_stepped_wedge()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_stepped_wedge.md)
  : Internal calculation: stepped wedge power (Hussey & Hughes 2007 Eq
  8)
- [`calculate_two_ordinal()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_two_ordinal.md)
  : Two-group comparison of an ordered categorical outcome (Whitehead)
- [`calculate_predictive_riley_binary()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_predictive_riley_binary.md)
  : Internal calculation: prediction model development (Riley 2020 BMJ
  method)
- [`calculate_predictive_timetoevent()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_predictive_timetoevent.md)
  : Internal calculation: prediction model for a time-to-event outcome
  (Riley 2020 criterion T1: person-years for precise cumulative
  incidence) Anchor: lambda=0.1/year, t=10, delta=0.05 -\> T \>= 2366
  person-years.
- [`calculate_predictive_epv()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_predictive_epv.md)
  : Predictive/prognostic model development: events-per-variable rule
- [`calculate_its_level()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_its_level.md)
  : Interrupted time series: level-change power (AR(1)-adjusted,
  experimental)
- [`calculate_kappa()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/calculate_kappa.md)
  : Internal calculation: Cohen's kappa sample size (Cantor 1996)

## Internal Validation & Utilities / 内部校验与辅助工具

Lower-level argument validation, standard normal quantiles, and
assertion utilities.

- [`validate_sample_size_result()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/validate_sample_size_result.md)
  : Validate a sample_size_result object
- [`assert_sample_size_result()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/assert_sample_size_result.md)
  : Assert an object is a valid sample_size_result
- [`validate_design_args()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/validate_design_args.md)
  : Validate design-specific arguments
- [`validate_alpha()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/validate_alpha.md)
  : Validate alpha (type I error) parameter
- [`validate_power()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/validate_power.md)
  : Validate power parameter
- [`new_sample_size_result()`](https://portos-wang.github.io/Sample_Size_Calc/reference/new_sample_size_result.md)
  : Internal constructor for sample_size_result objects
